subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the adventurer from Liyue

735250101.text: Geez, I'll have to trouble Lan again... But it's not like I have a choice. There's simply too much work, and I'm only one person. How am I supposed to finish?

735250102.text: I have no choice but to delay the mapping submission again. If this goes on, my living expenses here in Sumeru will exceed the deposit for the commission...

735250103.text: B-But there's nothing more terrifying than Lan's rage... *sigh*...

735250104.text: Huh? What's an adventurer from Liyue doing over here...?

735250105.text: Hey! You! From the Adventurers' Guild!

735250106.text: Huh? What's wrong? Am I not allowed to rest by the river here?

735250108.text: An adventurer from Liyue in Sumeru...

735250109.text: It's really rare! And you even look super anxious, so we came over to ask if we could help!

735250110.text: I see. I'm Peixiu, and you are?

735250111.text: #Paimon is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}! So, Peixiu, what are you doing here in Sumeru...? Ah! Paimon knows! Did you get lost!?

735250112.text: Ahahahaha! So the cute little one is Paimon! Hahaha, lost...

735250116.text: ...Under most circumstances, no, it wouldn't be funny. But asking a cartographer if he's lost is quite amusing.

735250118.text: Yes, we are responsible for surveying the landscape and updating older maps... It's one of the Adventurers' Guild's duties.

735250119.text: I am one such cartographer, but...

735250121.text: I'm just an apprentice. I've completed some rough sketches, but there are tons of mistakes. I need to get to a shaded valley or tunnel to carry out a detailed survey.

735250122.text: Ugh, this is killing me. The terrain here in Sumeru is so complex, and there are so many roads and caves too. Sometimes, I wonder if the entire mountain is hollow...

735250123.text: Progress is just way too slow... *sigh* I don't know the terrain as well as the locals do.

735250124.text: Huh? Then why don't you get a local adventurer to do it?

735250125.text: Er, it's actually a joint project between the Sumeru and Liyue branches of the Adventurers' Guild, and a completed map will be provided to those who trade or venture between the two.

735250126.text: It was entrusted to the Liyue branch because the Adventurer who was supposed to be in charge had cartographic experience, and her reputation is that of absolute reliability.

735250127.text: Supposedly, she already did something similar in Qiaoying Village. All it took was a single glance for her to know all the terrain inside and out, and her maps were very precise too.

735250128.text: But she left for some mining area. Uh, did she go to the Chasm or Blackcliff Forge...

735250129.text: Anyway, once we laid eyes on her map, we all felt ashamed of our own skills. The adventurers who used her map praised it to the skies!

735250130.text: I can't compete with that... I may have drawn a map, but there are too many omissions, and surveying everything again will take too long...

735250131.text: *sigh* I'm a stranger in a strange land. I may have the support of Sumeru's Adventurers' Guild, but I'm just not efficient enough. If this goes on much longer, the deposit I received won't even be able to cover my travel expenses.

735250133.text: We don't really know much about cartography though... Maybe Paimon can help mark where you can find delicious food on your map instead?

735250134.text: Haha! That's a great idea! A map showing all the best local cuisine would definitely be popular!

735250135.text: But... well, my remaining work doesn't really require drawing the map. What's left is a final survey to verify the map's accuracy...

735250136.text: There are a few dangerous locations surrounded by difficult terrain that I haven't been able to get to.

735250140.text: But most of these locations are really dangerous! There may even be monsters roaming around.

735250141.text: That's exactly why you should leave it to us!

735250142.text: R-Really...? With your help, it feels like I'll be done in no time! I may even make the deadline...

735250143.text: Most importantly, supplying travelers with an updated map will help prevent them from getting led somewhere deserted or dangerous by the old map!

735250144.text: Sounds great! Hehe, but we'll only help you on one condition! And that is that you have to mail us a copy of your food map once you're done making it!

735250145.text: Hahaha! But of course! However, this map has to be verified before any of that can happen! It's all up to you now!
